===Format===
*'''Group Stages''' (Best-of-3)
**There will be one group stage
**A group comprises of 4 players
**Groups are played in the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Round-robin_tournament Round-Robin Format] (All matches are played)
**The top 2 in each group will advance to the next stage
**From stage 1 to stage 2 the players will advance in a way that won't repeat any match-ups
**From stage 2 losers from the "Round of 32 Group Stage" main tournament will enter
*'''Playoffs''' (Best-of-3)
**8 players single-elimination bracket with bronze match
*'''Map picking'''
**Map pool: dm2, dm4, dm6, aerowalk, ztndm3. Dm6 may be switched with bravado, if both players agree beforehand.
**Best-of-3: The higher seeded player decides if he wants to pick first and toss last or vice versa (maps '''can''' be repeated)
*'''Allowed clients'''
**ezQuake >= v2.1 (ruleset smackdown, qcon, thunderdome)
**FodQuake >= v0.2 (ruleset eql)
**FTEQW >= v1.0 (ruleset nqr)
*'''Game settings'''
**The default /1on1 settings on the QHLAN servers apply
